title: The co-receptor Tetraspanin12 directly captures Norrin to promote ligand-specific beta-catenin signaling.
authors: Bruguera, Elise S; Mahoney, Jacob P; Weis, William I
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Norrin配体与共受体Tspan12及Fzd4的蛋白-蛋白结合机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及配体-受体互作界面建模（AlphaFold）和结合亲和力分析，方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Wnt/beta-catenin signaling directs animal development and tissue renewal in a tightly controlled, cell- and tissue-specific manner. In the mammalian central nervous system, the atypical ligand Norrin controls angiogenesis and maintenance of the blood-brain barrier and blood-retina barrier through the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. Like Wnt, Norrin activates signaling by binding and heterodimerizing the receptors Frizzled (Fzd) and low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 5 or 6 (LRP5/6), leading to membrane recruitment of the intracellular transducer Dishevelled (Dvl) and ultimately stabilizing the transcriptional coactivator beta-catenin. Unlike Wnt, the cystine knot ligand Norrin only signals through Fzd4 and additionally requires the co-receptor Tetraspanin12 (Tspan12); however, the mechanism underlying Tspan12-mediated signal enhancement is unclear. It has been proposed that Tspan12 integrates into the Norrin-Fzd4 complex to enhance Norrin-Fzd4 affinity or otherwise allosterically modulate Fzd4 signaling. Here, we measure direct, high-affinity binding between purified Norrin and Tspan12 in a lipid environment and use AlphaFold models to interrogate this interaction interface. We find that Tspan12 and Fzd4 can simultaneously bind Norrin and that a pre-formed Tspan12/Fzd4 heterodimer, as well as cells co-expressing Tspan12 and Fzd4, more efficiently capture low concentrations of Norrin than Fzd4 alone. We also show that Tspan12 competes with both heparan sulfate proteoglycans and LRP6 for Norrin binding and that Tspan12 does not impact Fzd4-Dvl affinity in the presence or absence of Norrin. Our findings suggest that Tspan12 does not allosterically enhance Fzd4 binding to Norrin or Dvl, but instead functions to directly capture Norrin upstream of signaling.
abstract_zh: Wnt/beta-catenin信号传导以严格调控的、细胞和组织特异性的方式指导动物发育和组织更新。在哺乳动物中枢神经系统中，非典型配体Norrin通过Wnt/beta-catenin通路控制血管生成以及血脑屏障和血视网膜屏障的维持。与Wnt类似，Norrin通过结合并使受体Frizzled (Fzd)和低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白5或6 (LRP5/6)异二聚化来激活信号传导，导致细胞内转导因子Dishevelled (Dvl)的膜募集，并最终稳定转录共激活因子beta-catenin。与Wnt不同，胱氨酸结配体Norrin仅通过Fzd4发出信号，并且额外需要共受体Tetraspanin12 (Tspan12)；然而，Tspan12介导的信号增强机制尚不清楚。已有研究提出，Tspan12整合到Norrin-Fzd4复合物中以增强Norrin-Fzd4亲和力，或以其他方式变构调节Fzd4信号传导。在此，我们测量了纯化的Norrin和Tspan12在脂质环境中的直接高亲和力结合，并使用AlphaFold模型探究这一相互作用界面。我们发现Tspan12和Fzd4可以同时结合Norrin，并且预形成的Tspan12/Fzd4异二聚体，以及共表达Tspan12和Fzd4的细胞，比单独表达Fzd4的细胞更有效地捕获低浓度的Norrin。我们还表明，Tspan12与硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖和LRP6竞争结合Norrin，并且Tspan12在存在或不存在Norrin的情况下均不影响Fzd4-Dvl亲和力。我们的发现表明，Tspan12并非变构增强Fzd4与Norrin或Dvl的结合，而是通过在信号传导上游直接捕获Norrin来发挥作用。
